story.title: Our story started from a gap in the market.
paragraphs: We noticed that buying a car - whether new or used - is a process full of complexities and concerns. We decided to change this reality by building an integrated digital platform that puts the customer at the center.

We believe that technology is the key to simplifying the complexities of financing, and providing the transparency that every buyer deserves, transforming the purchase journey from a daunting task into an enjoyable and trusted experience.

items.question: How do I apply for a car finance through Qemt Car?
items.answer: Applying for finance is easy and fast. Start by filling out the finance application form on the website or contact us via WhatsApp. The application usually requires a national ID, salary statement, and bank statement for the last 3 months. The application is reviewed within 24-48 business hours.

items.question: How do I apply for a car finance through Qemt Car?
